item.title: 🚀 Paper Accepted at 44th IEEE IPCCC 2025, Austin Texas ✨
item.description:
Happy to announce that our research paper on drone-based imaging has been accepted for presentation at the 44th IEEE IPCCC 2025, which will be held in Austin, Texas, USA during the last week of November.

In this work, we focused on evaluating deep learning model performance in relation to computational complexity, providing insights into achieving efficient yet accurate solutions for real-world drone applications.

Looking forward to sharing our findings with the global research community at this prestigious conference!

item.title: 🚁 Field Visit to BAU with IUB Research Team – UAV Data Collection
item.description:
Recently, I had the opportunity to be part of a research team from the RIoT Center, Independent University, Bangladesh (IUB), on a visit to Bangladesh Agricultural University (BAU), Mymensingh.

Our mission was to conduct a research coordination meeting and perform UAV-based image data collection for an ongoing agricultural project. The experience was both technically enriching and inspiring, as we explored multidisciplinary remote sensing research opportunities with the Agriculture University, while also continuing our previous work.

Looking forward to contributing to meaningful research outcomes that can support the future of agricultural innovation in Bangladesh!
